text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. Twin Turbo managed to 
enter through fan voting, but the 
competition is stacked with powerful 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Drawing the most attention is champion 
Mejiro McQueen, regarded as the strongest 
at middle and long distances, as she steps 
up to challenge unknown formidable 
opponents.
